versions.content: If the internal AUTOSAR COM module’s buffer is currently not locked and the parameter TpSduLength does not exceed the (maximum) expected length, the function Com_StartOfReception shall write the complete size of the AU- TOSAR COM module’s internal I-PDU buffer of the I-PDU with handle ComRxPduId to the position given by RxBufferSizePtr.
